text:
maya: Created RC 2026.03.20-rc42 from main for today's 16:00 UTC change window. Artifact: docker.redwood-inference/runtime:rc42 (sha: sha256:abc123def456). Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/2026-03-20-rc42 (internal). Please review pinning, rollback plan, and canary schedule.

deploy-bot: RC created: name=2026.03.20-rc42 image=docker.redwood-inference/runtime:rc42 sha=sha256:abc123def456 change_window=2026-03-20T16:00Z

sam: Quick note — we should pin model-weights to tag v1.4.2 in the helm chart to avoid midnight drift. I'll open a tiny PR to lock `model.weightsTag`.

cheng: Starting preflight smoke tests in staging now. Command: `/smoke rc42`

ops-bot: smoke-check: auth ✅, inference ✅, kv-cache ✅, tracing ✅ — all green (staging).

sam: Proposal for rollout: canary 5% for 15m -> 25% for 30m -> 100% if metrics stable. If p50 latency > 250ms or error_rate > 0.5% at any stage we abort. Thoughts?

elaine: I'll monitor latency and error-rate dashboards. Abort criteria noted. I'll sign off manually after the 5% window if metrics look good.

maya: Added rollback playbook to the release notes (section: rollback-and-mitigation). Pinned runtime in the rollout config. Snippet for ops: ```kubectl set image deployment/runtime runtime=docker.redwood-inference/runtime:rc42 --record```

cheng: Smoke is green. Starting canary ingress now — routing 5% to rc42. @sam starting time now.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: service=runtime canary_id=canary-rc42 target_traffic=5% duration=15m monitor=latency,error-rate

sam: Seeing a burst of 503s from pod runtime-2 at t+2m, scaling replicas to 6: `kubectl scale deploy runtime --replicas=6`

ops-bot: Autoscaler triggered and scaled runtime -> 6 replicas (cpu 85%).

elaine: After 15m: p50=180ms, p95=420ms, error_rate=0.12% — metrics within SLOs. I sign off for the 25% stage. :white_check_mark:

maya: Promoting canary to 25% now. Noting we have model-weights pinned and a migration note for kv-cache warmup.

deploy-bot: Canary update: canary_id=canary-rc42 new_target=25% next_check=30m

cheng: Reminder: rollback command if we need to revert: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/runtime --to-revision=42` and then run `./scripts/promote-bot rollback --id canary-rc42`. Playbook link: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/rollback

sam: All looks stable so far. Final approval from PM/Release owner? @elaine please confirm release notes and migration steps are acceptable.

elaine: Reviewed release notes, migration steps, and SLA callouts. Approved. :white_check_mark:

maya: I'm adding manual approval flag: `APPROVE_PROD_PROMOTE` — approved by maya at 2026-03-20T16:20:00Z.

deploy-bot: Promotion scheduled: rc=2026.03.20-rc42 window=16:31Z after canary duration completes.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete: rc=2026.03.20-rc42 promoted->prod at 2026-03-20T16:31:22Z. Note: monitor dashboards for 30m. Rollback window open until 2026-03-20T17:01:22Z.

sam: Will watch logs and alerting. If anything > abort thresholds, I'll trigger rollback.

cheng: Post-deploy checklist: postmortem lint, tag release in git, update internal changelog (I will handle tagging).

elaine: Nice work team. Please file any follow-up issues as small tickets and link to the RC page.

maya: Closing thread — capture quick notes to release doc and notify support channel. Thanks!
